commands.name: build
commands.help: Build one LTX-2.5 text-to-audio-video TensorRT bundle

arguments.name: model
arguments.help: Hugging Face model ID or local snapshot

arguments.name: vae_tile_pixels
arguments.help: Video VAE tile size in pixels (0: untiled spatial axes)

arguments.name: vae_tile_overlap_pixels
arguments.help: Minimum spatial tile overlap in pixels

arguments.name: vae_tile_frames
arguments.help: Video VAE tile length in frames (0: untiled time axis)

arguments.name: vae_tile_overlap_frames
arguments.help: Minimum temporal tile overlap in frames

arguments.name: two_stage
arguments.help: Also build the two-stage pipeline (half-resolution stage 1, latent upsampler, full-resolution refinement); run it with --set two_stage=true
